_comment: Single source of truth for /pr's review loop: the Slack channel and reviewer bot, the poll interval and
the round cap. scripts/wait-for-slack-reply.sh (--until verdict) reads this file and passes the bot id to
verdict-predicate.py; skills/pr/review-loop.md reads the same keys. To point /pr at another channel or bot, change
the values here and nowhere else.

bot_review_channel.name: #dev-enterprise
bot_review_channel._note: Slack Connect channel. Posts must use the user token via scripts/post-slack.js (MCP sends are blocked/ignored by the bot).

waiter._note: A real full review takes about 12-15 minutes; 10 timed out twice at AR-583.

review._note: Over this many changed files in one PR, or a verdict that ran out of tool budget, the review goes one PR at a time (skills/pr/per-pr-review.md).
review._note_full_review_gate: Full-review gate (review-loop.md Step 3.6): a re-run is worth its 7-15 minutes and ~3 USD only if the diff since the PR's last reviewed head sha has more than max_unreviewed_code_lines non-test, non-comment source lines, touches a sensitive_paths glob, or is longer than max_unreviewed_delta_lines in total. Raise the first to let small code fixes skip a re-run.

loop._note: Same default and meaning as review-loop's: one round = one new-reviewer-message triage-and-reply cycle. Reaching it is a stop-and-report, never a silent exit.
